description: Synthetic smoke set for stage 1: one small corpus with a single-hop fact, a bridge across two documents, a superseded decision, a saved memory, a hub rule, Korean text, and questions the corpus cannot answer. Written inline so its pages never enter this wiki's own index or link checks.

files.hub/operator/review-before-merge.md:
# Review before merge

Rule. Every pull request receives one independent review round before it is merged. The author's own checks are not a review.
files.hub/craft/one-retry-budget.md:
# One retry budget

Rule. A loop shares one deadline, one call count and one token ceiling across all of its steps. A step's own limit never multiplies the total.
files.repo/docs/ports.md:
# Ports

The search daemon listens on port 8791. The chat server listens on port 8787.
files.repo/docs/owners.md:
# Owners

The ingest pipeline is owned by the Atlas team.
files.repo/docs/atlas.md:
# Atlas team

## Rota

The Atlas team is on call every Tuesday and handles incidents for everything it owns.
files.repo/docs/decisions/cache-2025.md:
# Decision: translation cache in the checkout

The translation cache is stored as a SQLite file inside the repository checkout.
files.repo/docs/decisions/cache-2026.md:
# Decision: translation cache moved

This supersedes the 2025 cache decision. The translation cache is now stored under the user cache folder, never inside the checkout.
files.repo/docs/translate-limit.md:
# 번역 월 한도

번역 요청이 이번 달 한도를 넘으면 새 요청을 멈추고, 캐시에 있는 번역만 돌려준다.
files.repo/.wiki/memory/2026-09-20-login.md:
# Login decision

The user decided to keep password login and add passkeys later.
